releaseNotes: Public preview SDK for NexatomTT on Windows x64.

Adds the shared result model (one STOPPED result per processor after Stop), callbacks by value, board selection by USB port (connection_id; the FT601 serial is information only), auto-reconnect, nexatom_tt_get_file_saving_statistics, a statically linked runtime and CSV/TAB v2 and HDF5 schema 4 files; examples and manual updated.

Checked on Windows with Kintex K168_004 and Zynq Z080_004 through the Nexatom application on a library from the same source revision: connect, histogram Start/Stop, raw recording with file-saving statistics (Zynq) and clean disconnect; two boards on USB at once listed, opened and streamed independently.
Firmware catalogue 3 (Z080_004, K168_004) is included in firmware/. External analog validation and maximum sustained throughput remain pending.
